press_references.value: Artera Expands Its Validated Multimodal AI Platform to Metastatic Hormone‑Sensitive Prostate Cancer (mHSPC)

product_launches.description: Artera launched clinical availability of the ArteraAI Prostate Test (mHSPC), a multimodal AI-based prognostic test to estimate 5‑year prostate cancer–specific mortality in metastatic hormone‑sensitive prostate cancer patients treated with ADT plus ARPI.

press_references.value: Artera Secures CE Marking for Its AI Prostate and Breast Cancer Assays, Unlocking Global Expansion

product_launches.description: Artera began offering its ArteraAI Prostate Biopsy Assay and ArteraAI Breast Cancer Assay for clinical use across the EU and certain EFTA countries following newly granted CE marking under the EU IVDR, enabling commercial deployment of its AI cancer diagnostics platform in Europe.

press_references.value: Artera Unveils Data Demonstrating Prognostic and Predictive Utility in Breast Cancer at SABCS 2025

product_launches.description: Artera is promoting its MMAI-powered ArteraAI Breast Test as an available diagnostic product for personalized breast cancer care, highlighted alongside new validation data at SABCS 2025.

press_references.value: Artera Receives U.S. FDA De Novo Marketing Authorization for AI-Digital Pathology Software Revolutionizing Prostate Cancer Care

product_launches.description: Artera launched ArteraAI Prostate, an FDA-authorized AI-powered digital pathology software for prognosticating long-term outcomes in non-metastatic prostate cancer patients, marking a significant advancement in personalized cancer care.

press_references.value: The ArteraAI Prostate Test Enhanced with New Insights for Higher Risk Patients with Localized Prostate Cancer

product_launches.description: Artera has enhanced its ArteraAI Prostate Test with new insights to better guide treatment decisions for higher-risk patients with localized prostate cancer, increasing its clinical utility and impact.

press_references.value: Referral Management Market Valued at $8.6B in 2023, Projected to Reach $42.7B by 2033 at 17.5% CAGR

product_launches.description: In March 2024, Artera launched Artera Referrals, an expansion of its Harmony platform, to help healthcare providers optimize referral communications and reduce referral leakage. The product features automated outreach, queue management, and performance reporting to enhance patient engagement and loyalty.

overview_description.description: Artera develops medical artificial intelligence tests that personalize therapy for cancer patients. Its tests predict therapeutic benefits and prognosticate patient outcomes. The Artera platform is purely software, and runs on digital images of H&E histopathology images as part of routine clinical care.

about_short_description.short_description: Artera develops multimodal artificial intelligence-based predictive and prognostic cancer tests to customize treatments for cancer patients.

product.name: ArteraAI Prostate Test
product.description: An AI-based test that combines digital pathology images and clinical data to estimate prostate cancer risk and predict potential benefit from selected therapies.

product.name: ArteraAI Breast Cancer Test
product.description: A laboratory-developed AI test for HR+/HER2- early-stage invasive breast cancer that estimates distant-metastasis risk and assesses potential chemotherapy benefit.

product.name: Artera Multimodal Artificial Intelligence (MMAI) Platform
product.description: An AI technology platform that combines digital pathology and clinical data to develop prognostic and predictive cancer biomarkers for treatment decision support.
